description: This Java class 'HtmlWidgetRenderer' provides methods for rendering HTML widgets within the Ofbiz framework. It includes functionalities for appending whitespace, building boundary comments, managing named borders, and rendering boundary comments, among others. It is a base class extended by other widget HTML rendering classes.

classes.name: HtmlWidgetRenderer
classes.description: A base class for rendering HTML widgets in the Ofbiz framework, providing utility methods for boundary comments, named borders, and Ajax parameters.

methods.name: setWidgetCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the rendering of widget boundary comments.

methods.name: isWidgetCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether widget comments are enabled.

methods.name: appendWhitespace
methods.description: Appends a newline (CR/LF) to the given writer.

methods.name: buildBoundaryComment
methods.description: Constructs an HTML comment string indicating the start or end boundary of a widget.

methods.name: beginNamedBorder
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the beginning of a named border, depending on the border type and theme exemption.

methods.name: endNamedBorder
methods.description: Returns the HTML for closing a named border if applicable.

methods.name: formatBoundaryJsComment
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript comment string for boundary annotations.

methods.name: renderBeginningBoundaryComment
methods.description: Writes the beginning boundary comment to the provided Appendable if widget comments are enabled.

methods.name: renderEndingBoundaryComment
methods.description: Writes the ending boundary comment to the provided Appendable if widget comments are enabled.

methods.name: getAjaxParamsFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts parameters from a URL target string, formatted for Ajax calls, currently suitable for Prototype.js.
